conditions.detail: Freeze exclusive, scalar or corrective opposition and the generic-connector rival before annotation. Define contexts independently of the outcome, allow the rival its declared content/discourse associations, and state the candidate-dependent prediction that differs after matching. Specify held units, detectable effect and power. Supply independent scope/opposition bindings rather than inherited component glosses.

Bind the chosen semantic and source-boundary annotations independently of candidate identity and inherited renderer labels. Apply the relevant relation gates if an ordered inscription packet is proposed.

not_sufficient: A structural association compatible with both declared models.
Out-of-scope ordinary-language examples treated as empirical rejection of the restricted mechanism.
More pages without the missing discriminator or annotation binding.
result.reason: File existence and change labels do not establish condition truth; inspect evidence, fixed gates and source scope.
